name: Spelling mistake on the homepage banner

input.error_summary: A customer says the banner on the homepage has a spelling mistake: it says "Free delivry on all orders".
A customer is asking what time the warehouse opens on public holidays.
A colleague suggests adding a gift message option to the checkout page as a new feature.
A customer would like the product description of a jacket to mention that it is water resistant.
A few customers say the discount code SAVE10 is rejected at checkout and they cannot place their order.
Customers report that the product page for one jacket shows a price that is far too low.
Customers who just placed orders say the order confirmation email never arrives.
The checkout page is very slow and sometimes times out for some customers.
